newsitem.title: USA: Dynatech chairman says upbeat about FY 98.
newsitem.headline: Dynatech chairman says upbeat about FY 98.

text.p: Dynatech Corp Chairman John Reno said on Wednesday that he was upbeat for fiscal 1998 because of the company's first quarter's results.
Reno said in a press release, "First quarter business trends give us good reason to be upbeat for fiscal 1998."

The company reported an increase of 13 percent in net income for the first quarter ended June 30 of $9.0 million, or $0.52 per share, up from $8.4 million, or $0.46 per share, in the prior fiscal first quarter. Sales for the quarter
increased 29 percent to $104.3 million, up from $81.1 million in the prior first quarter.
The company's first quarter results, however, were below the First Call analysts' estimate of $0.53 per share.

Reno said "Deregulation in the telecommunications industry, particularly in the local service market, continues to drive our test business as an expanding base of communications service providers require test solutions.
"Internet growth and the worldwide expansion of wireless networks are also positive factors," concluded Reno.
Dynatech produces high technology products and systems used in collection, processing, analysis and display of information.
